comments.body:
> [@jankaluza](https://github.com/jankaluza) [@simek-m](https://github.com/simek-m)
> 
> conmon-v3 on rawhide seems to produce invalid log lines:
> 
> ```
> time="2026-11-13T18:06:01Z" level=error msg="Getting new log line: '2026-11-13T18:06:01.351546734+00:00 stdout F' is not a valid container log line"
> ```

Checking. Thanks for ping.

@Luap99 , this should fix it - https://github.com/containers/conmon-v3/pull/78. @simek-m has PTO today and there is a public holiday tomorrow, so if this PR can wait few days, we will most likely merge conmon-v3 fix on Wednesday. Otherwise I will have to find someone else to review https://github.com/containers/conmon-v3/pull/78.
